p.i: quâ medium fere Dullartus fluctus nunc agitat, sileam, omnibus prioribus quondam ampliore ac ditiore. Egregia ad hæc ædificys ac opulentia

monachorum & sacrarum virginum cœnobia in agro fuere numero xxv: ante catera verò Ado-ardia in Medachys, quinq; vicus imperans, famosissq; opibus inclita, superbo imprimis fano, ad modum & dimensionem ædis Claravallensis magnificentissimè structo, visenda, ædificys variys ac multis frequens, munitionibus & portis, vt oppidum, clausa, familia Bernardina: tum vetus Dammona vicinum Benedictinarum virginum, & alterum eodem nomine ac ejusdem ordinis in Marnensibus: Rottumum, Warsumum, Thesingaum, Seluverdia, Grisomonachum, Witta-werumum, Ofterwerumum, Wytwerdia, Hilli-gerlea, SchiltWolda; Effena etiam in præfectura suburbana. Præterea prapositura, sacerdotij genus opimum & honoratum, à Monasteriensi præsule εὐταξίας [?] ac quietis causa introductum in hæc loca, quatuor, Farmsumana, Loppershemia, Ufquerdia, Leensia: quinta in Hommercys jamdudum extrita. (collegium quoq; canonicorum, aut vt tum vulgo loquendi mos habebat, ecclesia collegiata apud Bedumanos cum fano ibidem illustri, supra fanorum rusticorum modum; cum primus sacerdos non temere alius, qui aut genere aut doctrinæ titulo conspicuus solet dari, magno honore atq; autoritate in populo. page.notes: Marginal note (left, beside the opening lines): "Cænobia vel claustra monastica." printed in three lines, hyphen after mo- kept. Greek word εὐταξίας is doubtful (accents and breathing not certain), marked [?]. The sign before "Monasteriensi" at the line end is unclear and is not transcribed. Place names Warsumum, Loppershemia, Hunesgoniys and Middelstbemia are uncertain in their letters and should be checked against the scan. Last line "steriensi." is the continuation of the word split at the line end; the printed hyphen after "Mona-" is kept. No heading or catchword on this page.
